Alias.name: refill lanterns
Alias.script:
-- Kill any leftover trigger from a previous run. if lanternRefillTrigger then killTrigger(lanternRefillTrigger) lanternRefillTrigger = nil end
-- One-shot trigger: fires when the sack runs dry mid-refill. lanternRefillTrigger = tempTrigger( "You use all of your oil in partially refilling your large iron lantern.", function() killTrigger(lanternRefillTrigger) lanternRefillTrigger = nil
send("keep empty oil sack") send([[put empty oil sack in "looties"]]) send([[get oil from "gear"]]) send("light lantern") send("light lantern 2")
cecho("\n<green>[lantern]<reset> oil swapped; lanterns lit.\n") end )
-- Start the refill; trigger fires only if the sack empties partway through. send("refill lantern") send("refill lantern 2")
-- Light both regardless: harmless if already lit, needed if they ran dry. send("light lantern") send("light lantern 2")
